post_call_analysis_data.name: outcome
post_call_analysis_data.description: Final outcome of the reminder call. confirmed = the person confirmed the appointment; rescheduled = the person was handed to the scheduling assistant to move it; transferred = handed to staff; voicemail = a voicemail message was left; queued = a request was sent to the front-desk queue; info_only = the person answered but did nothing else.

post_call_analysis_data.name: phi_beyond_scheduling_mentioned
post_call_analysis_data.description: True only if the person volunteered health information beyond scheduling, asked about a balance or billing, or gave an SSN or insurance member id.

post_call_analysis_data.name: sms_opt_in_given
post_call_analysis_data.description: True only if the person was asked the text-reminder opt-in question and clearly answered yes.

post_call_analysis_data.name: sms_opt_out_requested
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if the person said they do not want text messages or calls, or asked to stop receiving reminders.

action.text: Hello, this is an automated reminder from {{practice_name}} about an appointment on {{day}} at {{time}}. To confirm or make a change, please call us at {{callback_number}}. Thank you.
